description: Manage PDF bookmarks (Window > Interactive > Bookmarks): add a bookmark to a page, text anchor or text, nested under another; delete, rename, go to, move (arrange and nest) and sort bookmarks by page order or name.

destination.description: add: one of pageIndex, anchor or text

text.description: Text: a text anchor is made at it

find.description: Text to find in the document (matched case-sensitively); the match is used

frameId.description: A text frame id; the text in that frame is used

length.description: With start: how many characters; 0 or absent means the point at start

occurrence.description: With find: which match to use, 1 for the first (default 1)

selection.description: Use the current text selection or text cursor

start.description: With storyId or frameId: the first character, counted from 0

storyId.description: A story id (get_document_stories lists them); its text is used

name.description: The bookmark (add: the new bookmark's name)

parent.description: add, sort: the parent bookmark (default: top level)

position.description: move: where to move it, relative to reference

reference.description: move: the bookmark to move it before or after, or into (at_beginning / at_end); absent with at_beginning / at_end means the top level

sortBy.description: sort: page order (as the panel's Sort Bookmarks does) or name (default page)

name: manage_bookmarks
title: Manage Bookmarks
